Economic Committee

Agenda

Meeting: 21st meeting
Meeting number: M20/M/IQ/2026/21
Venue: Committee Room 10
Date: 26 October 2026
Time: 11:00

1. Meeting with Maldives Resilient Reefs, as they have requested to meet the Environment and Climate Change Committee and the Economic Committee to share the findings of the study they have carried out on the impacts of climate change on fisheries in the Maldives and the experiences of fishermen working in different parts of the Maldives.

Maldives Resilient Reefs is a Maldivian association working to build a future in which Maldivians receive the benefits of protecting reefs and managing those resources well.

At this meeting, it has been arranged for Maldives Resilient Reefs to screen "Rodhi", a 27-minute short film showing the experiences and views of Maldivian fishermen regarding changes to reefs and fisheries, and to give a 15-minute presentation covering the important matters identified by the study and the reforms that should be made to policies.

The persons attending this meeting on behalf of Maldives Resilient Reefs are:
1. Executive Director Ms. Aminath Shaha Hashim
2. Fundraising and Partnerships Manager Ms. Hawwa Naffath Nasir
3. Project Manager Mr. Aleef Abdulla Naseem
4. National Coordinator – Protected Areas Ms. Hana Farooq (not attending)

This meeting has been arranged to be held together with the Environment and Climate Change Committee.
